title: A built site whose last check found problems reads Needs review with Open demo, never Failed or an unexpected error
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A failed build with QA_NEEDS_REVIEW whose site is there reads review: Open demo, Build again in the menu, the review line.
Deleted, frozen, failed or missing sites, and every other code, still read failed.
Step 3 stays current as a review with Try again and the chip Site needs review; the list shows the site and Needs your review.

tests: a build that ends needing review while its site is online is review: Open the site, Build again in the menu
needing review is only review while the site is there: deleted, frozen, failed or rebuilding reads failed
a site built but needing review keeps step 3 current as a review, never Failed, with Try again
Demo: a site built but needing review shows its site and reads Needs your review, never Build failed
